description: Operator surface + docs: deploy.sh and destroy.sh (bash, set -euo pipefail, region ap-southeast-1 pinned, confirmation prompt on destructive steps), plus README.md and the five-act FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md. Depends on all prior FEATs because scripts and docs reference the real file layout, stack names, and commands they produced.
steps: Create <ROOT>/deploy.sh: bash with set -euo pipefail; AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION pinned to ap-southeast-1; ordered steps with echoed progress — cdk bootstrap note, docker build + push image to ECR, zip the SAM app source and upload source.zip to the S3 source bucket to trigger the pipeline, cdk deploy; at the end echo the ALB URL and API endpoint. Keep steps idempotent-ish.

Create <ROOT>/destroy.sh: bash with set -euo pipefail; region pinned ap-southeast-1; a confirmation prompt guarding destructive steps; tears everything down — cdk destroy, empty & delete S3 buckets, delete ECR images — so nothing is left billing.

Create <ROOT>/README.md: prerequisites (AWS CLI configured for a sandbox account, Docker, Node/CDK, Python, SAM CLI), architecture overview, cost warning (Fargate + ALB + pipeline cost real money per hour; public subnets avoid NAT cost), and exact deploy/destroy commands.

Create <ROOT>/FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md: five-act command-by-command live demo sequence — (1) infra as code: queue three ways, sam validate, change-set preview concept; (2) test before shipping: replay Lambda test events, sam local start-api, show the Kiro hook + headless gate; (3) package artifacts: ECR build/push/tag + lifecycle, publish Lambda version+alias; (4) the pipeline: Source->Build->test->manual approval(SNS)->prod; (5) deploy safely two ways: Lambda canary via CodeDeploy w/ alarm rollback, ECS rolling update w/ circuit breaker, AppConfig staged flag flip, Parameter Store vs Secrets Manager. Map each act to the services it demonstrates. Include a teardown reminder.
acceptance_criteria: Both scripts contain set -euo pipefail and pin ap-southeast-1; destroy.sh prompts for confirmation before destructive actions
README.md documents prerequisites, architecture, cost warning, and deploy/destroy commands that match the actual scripts
FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md contains all five acts with service mappings and a teardown reminder
verification: grep -q 'set -euo pipefail' <ROOT>/deploy.sh && grep -q 'set -euo pipefail' <ROOT>/destroy.sh && echo PIPEFAIL_OK
findings:
Operator surface + docs implemented and verified LOCAL-ONLY (no scripts run, no AWS resources created). Verification: SCRIPTS_PARSE (bash -n both), PIPEFAIL_OK, REGION_OK, CONFIRM_PROMPT_OK. Runbook has 5 Act sections + teardown; README has the cost warning. Both scripts made executable (chmod +x).

FILES CREATED (all at <ROOT>):
- deploy.sh: bash set -euo pipefail; AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION pinned ap-southeast-1. Steps: preflight tool check + sts get-caller-identity; cd infra && npm install && cdk bootstrap (idempotent); cdk deploy --all --require-approval never (stacks CoffeeShipNetworkData + CoffeeShipAppPipeline); docker build container/ + push to ECR repo 'coffee-ship' (${ACCOUNT_ID}.dkr.ecr.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/coffee-ship:latest); zip app/ -> upload as source.zip to the pipeline source bucket (resolved from CoffeeShipAppPipeline stack resources, NOT hardcoded, per FEAT-001 finding) to trigger pipeline 'coffee-ship'; resolves ALB DNS via elbv2 describe-load-balancers; resolves API endpoint from coffee-ship-app stack output OrdersApiEndpoint. Ends by echoing ALB URL (http://<dns>/) + API endpoint, with graceful fallbacks if not yet available.
- destroy.sh: bash set -euo pipefail; region pinned ap-southeast-1; confirmation prompt (read -r, must type 'destroy') guarding ALL destructive steps. Deletes SAM stack coffee-ship-app (if present); empties pipeline S3 buckets incl. versions/delete-markers (versioned bucket); batch-deletes ECR 'coffee-ship' images; cdk destroy --all --force. Each step guarded with 'if describe' existence checks so re-runs are safe.
- README.md: box table, architecture diagram (two deploy paths), prerequisites (AWS CLI v2 sandbox, Docker, Node/CDK, Python 3.12, SAM CLI optional), explicit deploy/destroy commands matching the scripts, and a prominent cost warning (Fargate+ALB+pipeline bill hourly; public subnets / 0 NAT; 256/512 Fargate desiredCount 1; ECR keep-10).
- FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md: five acts, each with command-by-command sequence + explicit service mapping. (1) IaC: queue three ways, sam validate, cdk synth/diff change-set preview -> CloudFormation/CDK/SAM/SQS. (2) Test before shipping: pytest, sam local invoke replay of events/*.json, sam local start-api, Kiro hook + headless gate -> Lambda test events/SAM CLI/CodeBuild/Kiro. (3) Package: ECR build/push/tag + lifecycle, Lambda version+alias -> ECR/Lambda. (4) Pipeline: upload source.zip, get-pipeline-state Source->Build->Deploy-Test->Approval->Deploy-Prod, SNS 'coffee-ship-approval' -> CodePipeline/CodeBuild/SNS. (5) Deploy safely two ways: Lambda canary Canary10Percent5Minutes + alarm rollback, ECS circuit breaker, AppConfig staged flag flip, SSM Parameter Store vs Secrets Manager. Teardown reminder at top and dedicated Teardown section (./destroy.sh).

All real names sourced from FEAT-001..004 findings: stacks CoffeeShipNetworkData/CoffeeShipAppPipeline, SAM stack coffee-ship-app, ECR/ECS/cluster/service/pipeline name 'coffee-ship', queue/table 'coffee-ship-orders', Lambda 'coffee-ship-loyalty' alias 'live', alarm 'coffee-ship-loyalty-errors', SNS 'coffee-ship-approval', SSM /coffee-ship/loyalty/points-per-dollar, secret coffee-ship/payment-provider-api-key, buildspec app/buildspec.yml, source key source.zip, container port 8080. Did NOT read/import from applications or demo/session3; never ran the scripts or any resource-creating AWS command.
